name: software-factory
description: Multi-agent build pipeline that turns GitHub/GitLab issues into merge requests

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Comma-separated list of repos to work, e.g. github:owner/name,gitlab:group/name

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identifier this worker uses when taking leases; left as "worker", each session uses <host>-<random>

tickMinutes.title: Tick interval (minutes)
tickMinutes.description: How often the worker polls the forges

parallel.title: Parallel jobs
parallel.description: Global cap on how many jobs one tick leases and advances at once

slackWebhook.title: Slack webhook
slackWebhook.description: Optional Slack incoming-webhook URL for notifications
